meta_description:
370 likes, 5 comments - theyogainstituteofficial on October 19, 2026: "Gussa aaye, darr lage ya bechaini ho sabse pehle kya badalta hai?

Hamari saans.

Woh chhoti ho jaati hai, tez ho jaati hai, aur mann aur bhi zyada ulajhne lagta hai.

Hum aksar samadhan bahar dhoondhte hain phone mein, distractions mein, ya kisi aur par apni pareshani nikaal kar.

Lekin kabhi-kabhi pehla kadam bahut simple hota hai:

Rukiye. Apni saans ko dekhiye. Teen gehri saansein lijiye.

Saans hamesha isi pal mein hoti hai. Aur jab dhyaan saans par aata hai, bhatakta hua mann bhi dheere-dheere vartamaan mein lautne lagta hai.

Agli baar koi mushkil aaye, pehle saans par laut aaiye.

Kyuki shanti kahin bahar nahi woh ek saans jitni kareeb hai. 🌿

#TheYogaInstitute #DrHansaji #Saans #Pranayama #BreathAwareness".
